Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.economics

Class BrazilSpecialParticipation

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.economics.BrazilSpecialParticipation
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class BrazilSpecialParticipation extends Object implements Serializable
Statutory Brazilian Special Participation (participação especial) for concession contracts.

Implements the progressive quarterly tables of Decreto nº 2.705/1998, Art. 22, which applies to fields in a concession area with large production volume. The charge is computed per field and per quarter from the net production revenue of the quarter (RLP, receita líquida da produção trimestral, after the deductions of Lei nº 9.478/1997 Art. 50 §1) and the fiscalised quarterly production volume (VPF, thousand cubic metres of oil equivalent). The rate band depends on the location of the field, the year of production counted from the start of production, and VPF.

Within a band the decree gives a rate and a "parcela a deduzir" written as D x RLP / VPF. The charge is therefore SP = rate x (RLP - D x RLP / VPF) = rate x RLP x (1 - D / VPF). The tabulated deductions make the charge continuous across band limits, which the unit tests verify. Negative net revenue in a quarter can be offset against later quarters of the same field (Art. 22 §6).

The values are those printed in the decree. One printed value breaks continuity: the shallow-water third-year 20 % band deduction is 775, whereas 725 would make the charge continuous at 950. The published value is kept; confirm the applicable value with ANP for a shallow-water field in its third production year.

Out of scope: computing RLP itself (the caller supplies it), ANP reference prices, unitised fields (Art. 23) and any contract-specific terms. Production-sharing (pre-salt PSC) contracts do not pay Special Participation; use PscBidEconomics and ProfitOilShareTable for those.

    • calculateAnnualFromEqualQuarters

      public static double[] calculateAnnualFromEqualQuarters(BrazilSpecialParticipation.Location location, double[] annualNetRevenue, double[] annualVolumeThousandM3oe)
      Computes annual Special Participation from annual totals by splitting each year into four equal quarters.

      This is a screening convenience for annual cash-flow models. Year index 0 is the first year of production. A seasonal or ramping profile within a year gives a different (usually higher) charge than equal quarters because the tables are progressive in the quarterly volume.

      Parameters:
      location - location class
      annualNetRevenue - net production revenue (RLP) per production year
      annualVolumeThousandM3oe - fiscalised volume per production year in thousand m3 oil equivalent
      Returns:
      Special Participation per production year
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the arrays differ in length
